name: Monsoon onset
description: Rain surges over Kerala as the southwest monsoon arrives.
selection_rule: late May-mid June start with the largest jump in Kerala rain over the next 10 days (validation years, best year)

name: Heavy-rain spell
description: A peak-monsoon spell with widespread heavy rain over land.
selection_rule: July/August start with the most land cells above 10 mm/day over the next 10 days (validation years, best year)

name: Pre-monsoon heatwave
description: The hottest 10 days over north-central India in May.
selection_rule: May start with the hottest next 10 days over north-central India land (validation years, best year)

name: Bay of Bengal low
description: The deepest sea-level pressure low over the Bay of Bengal.
selection_rule: start with the deepest Bay of Bengal sea-level-pressure low in the next 10 days (validation years, best year)

name: Western disturbance
description: A winter system bringing rain and snow to the far north.
selection_rule: December-February start with the most rain over the far north in the next 10 days (validation years, best year)

name: Quiet weather
description: The calmest 10 days: little day-to-day change anywhere.
selection_rule: start with the smallest mean day-to-day change over the next 10 days (validation years, best year)
